==About me! ==

I've been reading the Wheel of Time since the mid 1990's.&nbsp; Each time there's a new book out I&nbsp;re-read the others in order to keep everything fresh.&nbsp; Inevitably, I feel like I&nbsp;should read them all again after I finish the new book.&nbsp; Maybe sticking my observations on a wiki will help with some of that in the future.
